commands.review_summary:
This PR changes `resolveActionTarget` so normalized target resolution no longer overwrites `args.channelId` with a sanitized resolved target.

PR surface: Source +7. Total +7 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection shows the linked Slack bug can still flow through lowercased Slack delivery/session targets and canonical `to`-based message actions; I did not run a live Slack workspace reproduction.

target.title: fix(core): preserve channelId case when target resolution is pure normalization
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Slack message tool `delete`/`react`/`remove-reaction`/etc. actions fail with `channel_not_found` because the channel ID is lowercased during target resolution before being passed to the Slack Web API. Slack channel IDs are case-sensitive (C0BG72N6Z0V vs c0bg72n6z0v), and the lowercased form is rejected.

The root cause is in `resolveActionTarget`: after resolving `channelId` through the target resolver, the normalized result (which lowercases the entire `kind:id` string) always overwrites the original `channelId` -- even when the resolution was just case normalization with no directory/plugin match.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| src/infra/outbound/message-action-runner.ts | Only overwrite `channelId` when `resolutionSource !== "normalized"`. Pure normalization (prefix + lowercase, no directory/plugin match) does not carry canonical ID information, so the raw input is preserved for the plugin's own case-preserving parser. |

## Evidence

**Unit tests (52 files, 987 tests, all passed):**

```
 Test Files  52 passed (52)
      Tests  987 passed (987)
```

**Real behavior proof (Slack API):**

```
==================================================
 结果汇总
==================================================
 原始大小写 channel ID -> reactions.add:  ✅ 成功
 小写 channel ID -> reactions.add:        ❌ 失败 (channel_not_found)
 原始大小写 channel ID -> chat.delete:     ✅ 成功
 Hostname: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
 PID: 1076897
 Timestamp: 2026-07-10T01:04:42+08:00
==================================================
```

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
- Fixes #102800
